categoryDefinitions.ACTIVE_CANONICAL: Permanent canonical data store. Never move. Never ignore. Contains source of truth artifacts.
categoryDefinitions.ACTIVE_GATE: Active audit/gate scripts and their output reports. Keep until the gate is formally retired.
categoryDefinitions.ACTIVE_LEDGER: Human-reviewed tracking ledgers and reference data. Do not ignore or move.
categoryDefinitions.ACTIVE_REPORT: Active remediation work-in-progress reports. Keep until remediation is closed.
categoryDefinitions.GENERATED_REPORT: One-off or completed investigation/report output. Can be archived. Can be gitignored once moved.
categoryDefinitions.ARCHIVE_CANDIDATE: Not yet classified. Requires review before archiving.
categoryDefinitions.OBSOLETE_CANDIDATE: Contains outdated/incorrect data. Requires explicit approval to delete.
categoryDefinitions.UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_REVIEW: Could not classify. Manual review required.
